summary.headline: Scorpio and Sagittarius in Astrology
summary.text: Astrological descriptions of Scorpio and Sagittarius: their elemental, gendered, bodily, and moral qualities; associated countries; decans and regional influences; bodily rulerships; and diseases attributed to Scorpio.
